context: An office worker walks a barista friend through buying a laptop
purpose: Teach: ブラウザ/マウス/デジカメ/スイッチ/レンズ/液晶/割引/アフィリエイト

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ねえ葵ちゃん、新しいノートパソコン買いたいんだけど、一緒に見てくれない？
lines.en: Hey Aoi, I want to buy a new laptop. Could you come look with me?
lines.style: Casual female office worker, warm friendly tone, asking favor

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいよ〜！でも私、パソコンのこと全然わかんないよ。ブラウザがサクサク動けばオッケーくらい。
lines.en: Sure! But I know nothing about computers. As long as the browser runs smoothly, I'm fine.
lines.style: Bright cheerful barista, self-deprecating laugh, casual feminine speech

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 大丈夫、私が選ぶから。とりあえず液晶画面がきれいなやつがいいなって思ってて。
lines.en: It's fine, I'll pick. For starters, I want one with a really nice display.
lines.style: Calm reassuring tone, thinking out loud, female adult voice

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あ、この機種かわいい！しかも学生割引のシール貼ってあるよ、見て見て。
lines.en: Oh, this model is cute! And look, it has a student discount sticker on it.
lines.style: Excited pointing gesture, playful discovery, bubbly female voice

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 私もう社会人だってば。でも軽いね、昔のデジカメくらいの重さしかないかも。
lines.en: I'm already a working adult, remember. But it's light, maybe as light as an old digicam.
lines.style: Mock-offended then impressed, lifting laptop, female adult tone

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 電源スイッチどこ？あ、ここか。ねえ、ついでにワイヤレスマウスも買っちゃう？
lines.en: Where's the power switch? Oh, here. Hey, should we grab a wireless mouse too?
lines.style: Curious exploring buttons, casual suggestion, bubbly female tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいね、買っちゃおう。あと買う前にレビューサイトもチェックしておきたいかも。
lines.en: Good idea, let's get it. Also, I want to check review sites before buying.
lines.style: Practical decisive nod, planning ahead, calm female adult

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あー、でも最近アフィリエイト目的のレビュー多いから、気をつけた方がいいよ。
lines.en: Ah, but lately a lot of reviews are just affiliate-driven, so you should be careful.
lines.style: Knowing warning aside, slightly conspiratorial, conversational female

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ふふ、葵ちゃん意外と詳しいじゃん。眼鏡のレンズ越しに見るみたいに、ちゃんと見極めなきゃね。
lines.en: Haha, you actually know your stuff, Aoi. Gotta look closely, like through glasses lenses.
lines.style: Amused teasing laugh, warm affectionate banter between friends

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあこれ決めちゃいなよ！帰りにうちの店でラテおごるから、レジ行こ！
lines.en: Then just decide on this one! I'll treat you to a latte at my cafe, let's go pay!
lines.style: Enthusiastic encouraging push, generous friendly offer, upbeat female
